findings.observation: Reviewed the Engineering and Drainage Report section 03-drainage-and-detention.md which contains Table 1 showing all existing and proposed drainage areas. The largest existing drainage area is EX-107 at 2.14 acres. The total site drainage area is approximately 7.6 acres (confirmed in the drainage model overview). The project README indicates the HEC-HMS model includes 8 existing subbasins totaling ~7.6 acres. All individual drainage areas are well below 64 acres.
findings.reasoning: The checklist item requires a DCM-compliant Floodplain Study signed and sealed by a PE when the drainage area exceeds 64 acres. Per the grouping's Key Terms section, the 64-acre threshold gates whether a floodplain study is required (DCM § 1.2.6.A.1). The site's total contributing drainage area (~7.6 acres) is far below the 64-acre threshold, so this requirement does not apply.
findings.explanation: Drainage area is approximately 7.6 acres, well below the 64-acre threshold requiring a floodplain study.

These values are displayed both in tabular form (Sheet 16) and graphically on the grading plan (Sheet 21), and are explicitly in MSL/NAVD88 datum as confirmed by multiple sheets. findings.explanation: Finished floor elevations (553/548/543 MSL) are shown for the proposed structure on Sheet 16 (Building Information table) and Sheet 21 (Grading Plan).

findings.observation: Reviewed facts.md which states 'FEMA Flood Zone: Zone X — Area of Minimal Flood Hazard' and '100-Year Floodplain: Outside — neither FEMA nor COA fully-developed floodplain polygon intersects any of the three parcels'. Sheet 53 block-6.md confirms 'THIS PROPERTY IS LOCATED WITHIN ZONE 'X', AREAS OF MINIMAL FLOOD HAZARD'. Zone X is defined by FEMA as an area of minimal flood hazard, outside the 100-year and 500-year floodplains.
findings.reasoning: The condition for this checklist item is 'If FEMA floodplain on site'. The site is located in FEMA Flood Zone X, which is explicitly designated as an area of minimal flood hazard and is outside the FEMA 100-year floodplain. Multiple sources (facts.md, cover sheet, survey sheet) confirm no FEMA floodplain is present on the property. Since the triggering condition is not met, the requirement to delineate FEMA 100-year floodplain on plans does not apply.
findings.explanation: Site is in FEMA Zone X (minimal flood hazard), outside the FEMA 100-year floodplain. No FEMA floodplain exists on site.

The drainage area maps show no such features. With no floodplain on site and no indication of nearby mapped floodplain, this requirement does not apply.
findings.explanation: No floodplain (FEMA or COA) is on or near the site. Site is in Zone X (minimal flood hazard) with no floodplain intersections.
